rationales.A: Franklin is afraid precisely because it is not — Germans were arriving in great numbers.
rationales.B: Franklin writes 'Germanize us' because Germans were becoming so numerous — his fear is the measure of their numbers.
rationales.C: A ban would end Franklin's worry — he is writing because Germans kept coming.
rationales.D: Franklin says the opposite — Germans 'will never adopt our language or customs.'
rationales.general:
1. Hear the fear. Pennsylvania, founded by the English, becoming a colony of aliens.
2. Ask what makes the fear real. Germans arriving in such numbers that they might outnumber the English.
3. Name what it reveals. Background: by 1751 Pennsylvania was already the most diverse colony in America.
Remember: a writer's fear is evidence about the world he fears — ask what has to be true for the fear to make sense.

stimulus.text: Why should Pennsylvania, founded by the English, become a colony of aliens, who will shortly be so numerous as to Germanize us instead of our Anglifying them, and will never adopt our language or customs, any more than they can acquire our complexion?
